name: terminates_parallel.aux
statement: ∀ {l : List (Computation α)} {S c}, c ∈ l → Terminates c → Terminates (corec parallel.aux1 (l, S))

name: terminates_parallel
statement: WSeq (Computation α)} {c} (h : c ∈ S) [T : Terminates c] : Terminates (parallel S)

name: exists_of_mem_parallel
statement: WSeq (Computation α)} {a} (h : a ∈ parallel S) : ∃ c ∈ S, a ∈ c

have_tree.body: lem1 l <;> simp only [parallel.aux1, corec_eq, destruct_pure, destruct_think] at e' <;>

name: parallelRec
statement: WSeq (Computation α)} (C : α → Sort v) (H : ∀ s ∈ S, ∀ a ∈ s, C a) {a} (h : a ∈ parallel S) : C a

name: parallel_congr_left
statement: WSeq (Computation α)} {a} (h1 : ∀ s ∈ S, s ~> a) (H : S.LiftRel Equiv T) : parallel S ~ parallel T
